name: @bridge/eslint-plugin
description: ESLint rules for product code that uses a Bridge design system: bridge/no-hardcoded-style-values (raw values in style, sx, styled and theme objects, with the token to use) and bridge/prefer-ds-components (native elements and foreign UI libraries). Reads the tokens through @bridge/core and bridge.config.json.
author: Florian Gouloubi
